verdict.rationale: Persona's docs explicitly list Adverse Media, PEP, and Watchlist as native report types alongside identity verification within the same API/reports framework, and reports can be scheduled to run at regular intervals for continuous monitoring — all within one platform, one API surface, and one review pipeline (workflows/inquiries). This directly satisfies the one-vendor, one-API, one-review-surface requirement for combined identity + watchlist screening. Missing for 10: no independent/third-party corroboration or case study showing actual review-surface consolidation in practice, and no detail on adverse-media source coverage or match-review UI specifics.
